note: Openings seen on Indeed searches and verified by reading each posting. 'sponsorship' is only what the posting itself says: yes / no / not stated. Nothing here has been applied to.

openings.title: Senior Network Engineer
openings.note: Cisco, ISE, Firepower, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point. Recruiter posting, client not named.

openings.title: Infrastructure Engineer (Network and Endpoint)
openings.note: Government-agency project (IM8 compliance); also needs endpoint/Intune/M365 and desktop operations.

openings.title: Infrastructure Lead (Network & Systems)

openings.title: Senior Network Engineer
openings.note: Fortinet, NAC/802.1X, SD-WAN, OSPF/BGP. Needs BPSS clearance and says nationality/residency rules can apply, so ask about eligibility before applying.

openings.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
openings.note: States no visa sponsorship, and needs Azure/AWS depth and a UK driving licence.

openings.title: Senior Network Engineer (contract-to-hire)
openings.note: US citizens or green-card holders only. Skills (Cisco, Palo Alto, ISE) match but you cannot qualify.

openings.title: Senior Systems Engineer (Network Security)

openings.title: Senior Network Engineer - Wireless & Physical Security

openings.title: Senior Network Engineer, Backbone and Internet Edge
openings.note: Service-provider backbone (BGP, IS-IS, MPLS, DWDM) plus Python automation as a minimum. Apple's own careers page is the place to check sponsorship.

openings.title: Network Engineer
openings.note: Requires existing eligibility to work in Ireland (no sponsorship mentioned) and an Irish driving licence; junior grade (1+ years). Closes 12 Oct 2026.

openings.title: Sr. Network Engineer
openings.note: Juniper, Aruba ClearPass, Palo Alto, Fortinet, SD-WAN, BGP/OSPF. Posting mentions possible export-licence review for non-US-persons. Best international match seen.

openings.title: Senior Engineer (Internet Gateway & Infrastructure)
openings.note: ISP/telecom gateway (IIG, NIX, CDN, DCI) and automation; different domain from your enterprise background.

openings.title: Senior Network Engineer
openings.note: Remote, SGT hours, SGD 7,000-8,500/month. Cisco/Juniper/Meraki, RADIUS/CoA and wireless; hands-on escalation role.

openings.title: Senior Network Engineer
openings.note: 7+ years, Cisco Nexus/Catalyst, SD-WAN, SASE, NAC, firewalls, project delivery. Good fit for your CCNP Security/Enterprise.

openings.title: Senior Network Engineer
openings.note: 4-6 years, HPE Aruba and Check Point firewalls (Check Point is not on your CV); Ansible.

openings.title: Infrastructure Engineer (Network)
openings.note: Agency posting for a bank: 10+ years of network operations, CCIE preferred, Cisco ACI/VXLAN/EVPN focus.

openings.title: Senior Resident Engineer - Fortinet SD-WAN
openings.note: Requires existing eligibility to work in Singapore, and Fortinet NSE 4 or above is mandatory (your NSE7 has expired).

openings.title: Senior Network & Data Center Engineer (Contract)
openings.note: Cisco Nexus/ISE, Palo Alto, FortiGate, SD and VMware; asks for UK work authorisation (preferred). Contract, so Skilled Worker sponsorship is unlikely.

none_found.Germany: Only Berlin cloud/SRE roles surfaced (e.g. AWS/Kubernetes principal engineer). No enterprise network or network-security posting that fits.
none_found.Netherlands: Only a Dutch-language security engineer role at a nuclear-research site (Dutch, VOG/VGB screening) and junior network roles. None suitable.
none_found.China: Only a Shanghai OT/embedded-device cyber-security testing role posted in Chinese. Not a fit; employer sponsorship rules differ and are best checked directly.

United States.note: Employers that filed H-1B petitions for 'network engineer' titles in FY2025 (MyVisaJobs, from US Department of Labor data). This shows who has sponsored before, not who is hiring now. Look for current roles on each employer's own careers page, and ask about sponsorship. H-1B also depends on the annual lottery.
